config.manualsDir.description: Root folder of a manual pack, containing its runtime indexes and PDF manuals. Use an absolute path or a path relative to the workspace. On Windows, place SumatraPDF.exe in the pack root or its pdf subfolder to enable precise page jumps.
config.language.description: Select the extension language for views, commands, hovers, and messages.
config.additionalExtensions.description: Additional filename extensions to treat as LS-DYNA files.
config.scanner.fullScanLargeFiles.markdo:
Perform a full scan for the Include Tree and Keyword Index. When disabled, files larger than 500 KB are scanned only at the first and last 1,000 lines for better performance.

> **Warning:** Enabling this can make projects with very large mesh files slow to load.
config.ignoreFormattingKeywords.descript: Keywords or prefixes to exclude from automatic formatting, smart Tab alignment, and field-comment completion.
config.customValidKeywords.description: Additional valid keywords that should not be reported as unknown. Include the leading asterisk (for example, '*END'). Add a trailing wildcard (for example, '*MAT_*') to match every keyword with that prefix. Entries can also be added from a hover or Quick Fix.
config.unknownKeywordSeverity.descriptio: Diagnostic severity for keywords not found in the built-in library or custom valid list. This does not affect keywords beginning with ** or lowercase-keyword warnings.
config.warnLowercaseKeyword.description: Warn when a keyword contains lowercase letters (e.g. *node). LS-DYNA is case-insensitive, so this is off by default; enable it if your team keeps keywords uppercase.
config.enableTabNavigation.description: Enable smart Tab navigation and field overwrite selection in LS-DYNA cards. When disabled, Tab inserts spaces or tab characters normally.
config.enableCellEditProtect.description: With this enabled, Delete or Backspace clears a selected fixed-width field with spaces so later fields do not shift. Typing replaces the whole field only after Tab selects it; * and $ always use standard text editing. This setting is independent of Tab navigation.
config.enableFieldHover.description: Show help when the pointer rests on a fixed-width card field. Turn this off to avoid field popups while editing; turn it back on from DynaSense quick actions.
commands.changeMarks.next.title: Go to Next Change Mark
commands.changeMarks.previous.title: Go to Previous Change Mark
commands.changeMarks.resetOrigin.title: Reset Change Marks Baseline
commands.changeMarks.diffUnsaved.title: Diff: Unsaved Changes
config.changeMarks.enabled.description: Show session change marks in the editor gutter. By default, amber marks are unsaved and green marks were saved after the file was opened. A solid bar means modified, a hollow bar means inserted, and a triangle marks a nearby deletion. Git is not required.
config.changeMarks.colorScheme.descripti: Choose one color scheme for all session change marks. Every preset automatically adjusts for light, dark, high-contrast, and high-contrast-light themes.
config.changeMarks.colorScheme.enumDescr: Recommended: automatically use the classic amber/green palette for the active light, dark, or high-contrast theme.
Use an orange/blue palette with strong hue separation; colors still adapt to the active theme.
Use a red/blue palette that makes unsaved changes especially prominent; colors still adapt to the active theme.
Use the highest-contrast preset for the active theme.
Use the two custom colors below.
config.changeMarks.customUnsavedColor.de: Custom color for unsaved changes, in #RRGGBB format. Used only when Change Marks: Color Scheme is Custom.
config.changeMarks.customSavedColor.desc: Custom color for changes saved since the file was opened, in #RRGGBB format. Used only when Change Marks: Color Scheme is Custom.
config.changeMarks.maxLineCount.descript: Skip change marks when a document has more lines than this (protects very large mesh decks).
config.changeMarks.debounceMs.descriptio: Milliseconds to wait after typing before recomputing change marks.
config.changeMarks.showOverviewRuler.des: Also show change marks on the overview ruler (scrollbar).
config.changeMarks.showLineBackground.de: Apply a very light background to marked lines. Turn this off to keep only the gutter marks.
config.changeMarks.showMinimap.descripti: Show unsaved and saved-since-open marks on the minimap using the selected color scheme. Modified, inserted, and deleted shapes remain in the editor gutter.
colors.changeMarks.unsaved.description: Session change marks for unsaved lines in the gutter, overview ruler, and minimap.
colors.changeMarks.saved.description: Session change marks for lines saved since the file was opened, shown in the gutter, overview ruler, and minimap.
commands.lsdynaCellDeleteRight.title: Clear Card Field (Delete)
commands.lsdynaCellDeleteLeft.title: Clear Card Field (Backspace)
config.navigation.pulseOnJump.descriptio: Highlight the target line briefly after jumping to a keyword usage.
config.statusBar.level.description: Amount of information about the current LS-DYNA file shown in the status bar. Off hides the entry; Simple shows problems or the current keyword; Detail also shows the field index and latest Include Tree scan root.
Hide the LS-DYNA status bar entry.
Show problems in the current deck or the current keyword.
Show Simple content, the field index (for example, 3/8), and the latest Include Tree scan root.
config.health.showFirstRunNotice.descrip: Show a one-time DynaSense notice when an LS-DYNA file needs environment or manual setup.
config.autoFormat.description: Experimental: choose when automatic LS-DYNA card formatting runs. Keep this disabled unless you are comfortable with edits when the cursor leaves a line.
config.autoFormat.enumDescriptions.onBlu: Experimental: format the current line when the cursor leaves it. This may rewrite card spacing unexpectedly.
config.largeFile.enableRendering.descrip: Keep syntax highlighting, hover help, formatting, and completion enabled for files of any length. Disable this to save memory when working with files above 100,000 lines.
config.codeLens.showOnAllKeywords.descri: Show Select Cards and Format actions above every LS-DYNA keyword. Keywords with optional suffixes also show Configure Options. When disabled, use the keyword hover actions, editor context menu, or Command Palette.
config.hover.previewMaxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to display in the *INCLUDE file hover preview.
config.include.pathCaseCheck.description: How path casing is checked for *INCLUDE and *INCLUDE_PATH. Windows can open mismatched casing; Linux LS-DYNA usually cannot.
config.include.pathCaseCheck.enumDescrip: Recommended for Windows preprocessing and Linux solving: allow local file navigation, but warn when the path in the deck differs in case from the path on disk.
Do not check include path casing.
Report case mismatches as errors and disable navigation for those include files. Use this before submitting a job on Linux.
